children: Digital Brands provided an investor update detailing a two-year $165 million U.S. Program and progress in its go-private review with a 60-day go-shop ending October 5, 2026.
Two-year $165M binding U.S. Program supplies apparel, footwear and toiletries to 771,481 residents; total units 23,915,880.
Contract secures $3.3M guaranteed cash flow from Sept 1–Dec 31, 2026, from the first two markets of the program.
Company forecasts a 15%–18% cash flow margin for the U.S. Program, indicating anticipated profitability.
Board retained Roth Capital; evaluating a $77.58/share proposal and running a 60-day go-shop through Oct 5 to solicit higher bids.
Due diligence on strategic alternatives expected to conclude by Oct 5, clearing path to finalize optimal transaction or strategy.
